headerDisplay: Use the settings UI above to sign in to your Vivint account (including multi-factor authentication) and obtain a refresh token automatically.

refreshToken.title: Vivint Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Session token obtained by signing in through the plugin settings UI (or 'npm run mfa').

apiLoginRefreshSecs.title: API Session Refresh (seconds)
apiLoginRefreshSecs.description: How often the plugin renews its Vivint session. Device state is polled at 1/20th of this interval. Lower values increase API traffic and the risk of being rate limited.

ignoreDeviceTypes.title: Ignore Devices
ignoreDeviceTypes.description: Selected device types / equipment codes / IDs are ignored on startup. Useful for external integrations like Nest or MyQ that are managed directly by another Homebridge plugin.

logDeviceList.title: Show device list
logDeviceList.description: Logs data for all configured Vivint devices at startup.

disableCameras.title: Disable cameras
disableCameras.description: If checked, camera video feeds will not appear in Homebridge.

useExternalVideoStreams.title: Use external video streams
useExternalVideoStreams.description: Stream camera feeds from Vivint servers instead of streaming directly from the panel on the local network.

showCameraConfig.title: Show camera config
showCameraConfig.description: Logs configuration for all detected cameras (RTSP credentials are redacted).

lowBatteryLevel.title: Low battery level (%)
lowBatteryLevel.description: Battery percentage at or below which a device reports a low battery. If unset, the device's own low battery flag is used.

motionDetectedOccupancySensorMins.title: Occupancy sensor timeout (minutes)
motionDetectedOccupancySensorMins.description: If greater than 0, each motion sensor also exposes an occupancy sensor that stays triggered for this many minutes after motion.
